steps.en: Bring up the stack with Docker Compose
steps.zh: 用 Docker Compose 把服务栈起起来

steps.en: Open localhost:9001 and create the first account
steps.zh: 打开 localhost:9001，建第一个账号

steps.en: Keeps files in Postgres and assets in the storage you pointed it at
steps.zh: 文件存进 Postgres，素材进你指定的存储

steps.en: Design in the browser and invite the team onto the file
steps.zh: 在浏览器里设计，把同事拉进同一个文件

steps.en: Syncs every peer live over WebSocket and holds the comments
steps.zh: 通过 WebSocket 实时同步每个人，评论也留在文件里

steps.en: Hand CSS/SVG off from Inspect, or wire an agent to the MCP server
steps.zh: 从 Inspect 取代码交付，或把 agent 接上 MCP

steps.en: Lets the agent read and rewrite the focused page through the plugin bridge
steps.zh: 让 agent 通过插件桥读写当前页面

value.en: The team edits one file on servers you control, in a format that does not lock you in
value.zh: 团队在你自己的服务器上共同编辑同一个文件，格式不把你锁死
